d:
A massive bovine-avian hybrid with a heavy, muscular build, featuring earthy brown plumage and thick, greyish hide. The head features two large, curved ivory horns and calm, wide brown eyes. The wings are broad with earthy brown feathers and the tail is a thick, tufted brown bovine tail. Three heavy claws per foot and three sharp talons per wing-hand.
BODY COLOR: earthy brown
